scope: Only the confirmed new physical-unit Eniraw evidence polarity, its announcement-to-actual production/absence assertions, and EPCM temporary price-no-impact wording. No additional model/source categories introduced by this review.

checks.evidence_prices_and_hollow_templates: An explicit up price mechanism belongs in bullish evidence and down in bearish. A company/project fact with only a bare TTF bullish/bearish endpoint must state a source-grounded supply/demand/capacity/expectation channel. Net direction is not assigned. Source-supported demand/expectation counterfacts and weaker upward pressure retain valid interpretation.
checks.historical_scope: Historical waiver is confined to explicit mechanism historical context; a fact segment containing 此前 or 低于此前预期 cannot hide a current wrong-bucket TTF up conclusion. Source-backed expectation-gap bullish evidence remains permitted by the whole collector.
checks.bare_entity_physical_stop: Named active unavailability capacity is not proof of actual production stop. Same-entity bare current stop must have known affirmative actual-state source. Notice descriptions, future/conditional/invalidation premises and independently confirmed actual stop pass. A source saying actual production 未停止/没有停止 cannot count as positive stop confirmation.
checks.active_absence_vs_future_degree: Active no-significant-supply-interruption is not established by missing flow data or a small price change. A known, explicitly scoped future notice not yet started retains the preexisting degree judgment; active mixed notices/global/metered/zero-price claims cannot borrow that exception.
checks.temporary_price_absence: 对TTF价格暂无即时影响 is an unqualified zero-effect assertion without a reaction source. Weak/limited transmission judgments, conditional/expected propositions, observation absence, negations and known comparable reaction observations are not globally banned. Future reaction evidence remains unavailable.
checks.input_and_label_boundary: Only validators/new local helpers change. Shared source extraction, prospective classification, fact projection, analysis.py, prompt, schema and output budgets remain unchanged. No directions/scores/confidence are rewritten; actual error/retry paths may change and must be proven after application.
checks.immutable_known_errors: Fifteen prior known-bad actual/fixture bodies plus the two new Eniraw and EPCM bodies remain rejected under the complete semantic collector. This is not a retrospective successful generation; current original strict flags/results/failed service runs remain untouched.

focused_tests.warning: Existing unknown asyncio_mode pytest option in the selected interpreter; all focused checks completed.

qualifications: These are bounded lexical/source invariants, not proof that arbitrary new output text has correct causality.
Weak/flat/down/up judgments are kept separate from unsupported physical or observed price-effect facts; no desired flat frequency is imposed.
The exact original Eniraw/EPCM still contain their identified errors; only new final-source actuals can establish delivery success after applying the fix.
A new full production live/manual/detail/English workflow and final coherent public code/report manifest remain required; previous failed public identity checks and production attempts are preserved.
Official complete-path replay must establish which old actual request/retry paths remain equivalent; source changes are never relabelled as having generated old records.
